items.html: And the matter is that the Sefira of Netzah, of Arich Anpin, of Aba and Ima, and of ZA — all of them are shorter than the measure of the Sefira of Hod within them. For the Sefira of Hod spreads below Netzah; and so the Sefira of Netzah is the short one, being higher, above the Sefira of Hod.
